data.name: Denali Visitor Center
data.description: Open in summer only, this is the main visitor center near the park entrance. During the summer, you can explore exhibits, watch the park film, pay the park entrance fee, and talk with a ranger. In fall, winter, and spring, the Murie Science and Learning Center (MSLC) acts as the park's Winter Visitor Center.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: The primary stamp for visitors to Denali National Park & Preserve features an outline of Mount McKinley, North America's highest mountain, and a caribou.

passportStampImages.title: Denali Visitor Center Passport Stamp

data.directionsInfo: Upon arriving in Denali, travel 1.5 miles down the road until you see signs for the Denali Visitor Center.

operatingHours.description: The Denali Visitor Center is open in summer only, from early May through late September. Full summer hours are in effect June through August. Hours are slightly reduced in May and September.
operatingHours.name: Denali Visitor Center

data.name: Murie Science and Learning Center
data.description: The Murie Science and Learning Center (MSLC) is located at Mile 1.3 of the Denali Park Road at the entrance of Denali National Park and Preserve. In winter, the MSLC is Denali’s Winter Visitor Center. The MSLC is closed to the public in summer, when it serves as an operations base for registration-based educational programs. A 24-hour Automated Fee Machine is located outside the building. You can purchase the park entrance fee and Denali Annual Pass here by credit card only.

passportStampImages.altText: stamp of the outline of a mountain and horned sheep with text: Murie Science & Learning Center
passportStampImages.title: Murie Science & Learning Center Stamp

data.directionsInfo: After entering the park, travel 1.4 miles and look for signs to the Murie Science and Learning Center.

operatingHours.description: The Murie Science and Learning Center (MSLC) is open daily from 9:30 am to 5 pm during the winter season, except on major holidays (Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, New Year's Day). A heated building, called the Indoor Picnic Area, is located next door to the MSLC. The Indoor Picnic Area is open daily 9:30 am to 5 pm from mid-October through April 20, except on major holidays. In summer, the MSLC is open to the public Wednesday through Sunday from 10 am to 4 pm.
operatingHours.name: Murie Science and Learning Center

data.name: Walter Harper Talkeetna Ranger Station
data.description: Located in the town of Talkeetna, about 100 miles south of the entrance to Denali National Park and Preserve, this ranger station serves as the center of mountaineering operations. Climbers wishing to attempt Mount McKinley or other peaks in the Alaska Range stop here first, for an orientation to the mountain and to acquire their climbing permit. This ranger station also offers some visitor services, particularly in summer. It is open year-round.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: The Walter Harper Talkeetna Ranger Station is located in Talkeetna, Alaska, about 2.5 hours drive south of the main entrance to Denali National Park. Visitors must travel on Highway 3 to the Talkeetna Spur Road, and then drive 15 miles into town to find the ranger station in "downtown" Talkeetna. This is the starting point for most mountaineering expeditions to climb Mount McKinley, Mount Foraker, and other noteworthy peaks in the Alaska Range.

passportStampImages.altText: stamp of a mountain outline, two ice axes, and words talkeetna alaska, denali national park
passportStampImages.title: Walter Harper Talkeetna Ranger Station

data.directionsInfo: The Talkeetna Spur Road is at Mile 100 on Highway 3. Drive down the Talkeetna Spur Road its full 15 mile length to the town of Talkeetna and look for the visitor center on B street.

operatingHours.description: Throughout the main summer season (mid-April to mid-September), the ranger station is open daily from 9 am to 4 pm. Hours are limited and vary in fall, winter, and spring. Call to speak with a ranger about visiting during winter months.
operatingHours.name: Walter Harper Talkeetna Ranger Station

data.name: Denali Bus Depot
data.description: This summer facility is operated by our concessionaire rather than by the National Park Service. It is the primary place to buy bus tickets, arrange for stays in park campgrounds, or to check in for an existing reservation. Coffee and grab-and-go food is also available for purchase. Only credit cards are accepted here.

passportStampImages.altText: stamp showing outline of a mountain, a school bus, and text: denali bus depot, denali park, alaska
passportStampImages.title: Denali Bus Depot

emailAddresses.description: This facility is operated not by the National Park Service, but by a concessionaire—Doyon/Aramark Joint Venture.

operatingHours.description: Open: May 20 through mid-September each year (closing date varies). Daily hours: 5 am to 7 pm for coffee service, bus loading, ticket sales, and pre-booked bus and campground reservation check-ins.
operatingHours.name: Denali Bus Depot

images.caption: Begin your day in the park at the Denali Bus Depot.

images.title: Denali Bus Depot

images.caption: Run by Denali's concessionaire, the Denali Bus Depot is where visitors can book campgrounds, buy bus tickets, and board most buses heading into the park.

data.name: Indoor Picnic Area
data.description: A heated building, called the Indoor Picnic Area, is located next door to the Murie Science and Learning Center. Open in winter only, mid-October to mid-April. Restrooms and a water bottle filling station are available. Food service is not provided, so bring your own food to eat.
data.directionsInfo: Turn off Highway 3 onto the Denali Park Road and drive 1.4 miles til you see signs for the Murie Science & Learning Center. Park at the Murie Center, and walk past it to the Indoor Picnic Area.

operatingHours.description: The Indoor Picnic Area is open to visitors in the winter, from 9:30 am to 5 pm daily, except on major holidays (Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, New Year's Day). NPS staff are not present.
operatingHours.name: Indoor Picnic Area

images.caption: The Indoor Picnic Area is a warm space where you can warm up during a winter visit.

images.title: Indoor Picnic Area space

images.caption: Bring your own food to eat and watch a park film while relaxing inside the Indoor Picnic Area.

data.name: Eielson Visitor Center
data.description: The Eielson Visitor Center is located at Mile 66 of the Denali Park Road. Due to the ongoing Pretty Rocks landslide and the closure of the park road at Mile 42, Eielson is currently closed.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: The Eielson stamp is available in summer only, when the facility is open—generally, June 1 to mid-September each year.

passportStampImages.altText: A stamp depicting a mountain and glacier, with text Eielson Visitor Center Denali National Park
passportStampImages.title: Eielson Visitor Center Stamp

data.directionsInfo: Eielson is located at Mile 66 of the Denali Park Road, and as such can only be accessed by visitors on certain buses, or visitors who are hiking / biking the road.

operatingHours.description: Currently closed due to the Pretty Rocks Landslide.
operatingHours.name: Eielson Visitor Center
